part.text:
All tests pass and the package builds cleanly.

Implementation in `bottle_song.go`:
- `Recite(startBottles, takeDown)` loops from `startBottles` down to `startBottles - takeDown + 1`, emitting one 4-line verse per iteration with a blank line between verses.
- A `numbers` table (`no` … `ten`) supplies the spelled-out counts; `capitalize` uppercases the first letter of the count in lines 1–2.
- A `plural(n)` helper returns `""` for 1 and `"s"` otherwise, applied to "bottle" in all three count-bearing lines — handling the singular cases "One green bottle hanging on the wall," and "There'll be one green bottle hanging on the wall."

I defined my own `capitalize` rather than reusing the `Title` helper from the test file, so the package compiles standalone (defining `Title` in the solution would collide with the test file's copy).
